company.name: THEYA
company.shortDescription: THEYA is a Bitcoin self-custody app for users who find crypto exchanges risky and hardware wallets overwhelming.
company.description: THEYA is a company that operates in the cryptocurrency, fintech, and mobile apps industries. The company offers a Bitcoin self-custody app that provides a simple solution for users to manage their Bitcoin assets. The app is designed to mitigate the counterparty risks associated with crypto exchanges and the single point of failure associated with hardware wallets. THEYA's app utilizes multi-signature, self-custodial wallet technology to enable seamless and secure self-custody of Bitcoin private keys.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile and web application providing Bitcoin self-custody through modular multi-signature vaults, enabling users to securely manage their Bitcoin keys with options for offline, shared, or mobile key storage.
productsAndServices.name: Theya Bitcoin Self-Custody App

productsAndServices.description: Multi-signature vaults requiring multiple key approvals (e.g., 2-of-3 or 3-of-5) to authorize Bitcoin transactions, enhancing security by eliminating single points of failure.
productsAndServices.name: Theya Multisig Vaults

productsAndServices.description: A feature allowing users to delegate custody of Bitcoin keys to trusted family members or financial advisors with customizable access controls.
productsAndServices.name: Shared Custody Feature

productsAndServices.description: Recovery options that allow users to regain access to their Bitcoin funds even if keys are lost or Theya's service is unavailable.
productsAndServices.name: Sovereign Vault Recovery

productsAndServices.description: A platform enabling financial advisors to securely manage clients' Bitcoin using collaborative custody and multisig vaults with features like co-signing, client onboarding, and portfolio insights.
productsAndServices.name: Theya for Advisors

items.description: Theya, a Bitcoin self-custody platform, and Arch, a Bitcoin-backed lender, have announced a partnership to offer secure, collateralized Bitcoin-backed loans to businesses, enabling access to USD liquidity without selling Bitcoin. The partnership integrates Arch's lending model with Theya's platform, with Anchorage Digital Bank serving as the custodian for collateral.
